work.summary: Cybersecurity analysts monitor digital systems, investigate suspicious activity, assess weaknesses, and help organisations reduce risks to information and services.
work.whyItMatters: Their work helps keep essential data and digital operations available, trustworthy, and safer for the people who depend on them.

activities.title: Monitor security events
activities.description: Review alerts and system activity to identify events that may require investigation or a defensive response.

activities.title: Investigate incidents
activities.description: Collect and analyse technical information to understand what happened, what was affected, and how recurrence can be reduced.

activities.title: Assess vulnerabilities
activities.description: Examine systems and security controls for weaknesses, then document practical steps for improving protection.

activities.title: Explain security risks
activities.description: Translate technical findings into clear recommendations that colleagues and decision-makers can understand and act on.

settings.environment: Technology, security, consulting, finance, public-sector, or other digitally dependent organisations
settings.description: Most work is computer-based and collaborative; incident-response responsibilities can occasionally require work outside standard hours.

educationPathways.title: Flexible school-to-diploma or degree route
educationPathways.description: A flexible example through IIT Madras that accepts learners from any Higher Secondary stream and provides certificate, diploma, degree, postgraduate-diploma, and M.Tech exit points.

timeline.title: Grade 10
timeline.description: Build a sound base in Mathematics and English; IIT Madras says applicants are expected to have studied both subjects in Class 10.

timeline.title: Higher Secondary
timeline.description: Complete Class 12 or equivalent. This route accepts applicants irrespective of academic background, and Class 11 students may apply irrespective of group or stream.

streamOptions.notes: Science, Commerce, Humanities, and Vocational learners may apply; Mathematics and English at Class 10 are expected.

timeline.title: Qualifier process or JEE-based entry
timeline.description: Regular-entry applicants complete four weeks of coursework and the qualifier process; candidates eligible for the latest JEE Advanced may enter the Foundation Level directly.

timeline.title: Foundation Level
timeline.description: Complete the eight Foundation Level courses and 32 credits before moving to Diploma Level courses, or use the foundation certificate as an exit point.

timeline.title: Programming or Data Science Diploma
timeline.description: Continue through one or both IIT Madras diploma levels, each with courses and projects, or exit with the completed diploma credential.

timeline.title: BSc or BS Degree
timeline.description: After completing the prerequisite levels, continue to the BSc in Programming and Data Science or BS in Data Science and Applications.
qualificationExamples: BSc in Programming and Data Science
BS in Data Science and Applications

timeline.title: Optional PG Diploma or M.Tech
timeline.description: Learners who complete the BS may optionally continue to the PG Diploma and then M.Tech in Artificial Intelligence and Machine Learning.
qualificationExamples: PG Diploma in AI and ML

entranceExams.name: Eligibility to appear for the latest JEE Advanced

educationPathways.title: Science stream to a specialised B.Tech
educationPathways.description: A specialised private-university route through Amrita's four-year B.Tech in Computer Science and Engineering with Cyber Security, with optional postgraduate study later.

timeline.title: Grade 10
timeline.description: Complete Grade 10 before the 10+2 science preparation required for this engineering route.

timeline.title: Higher Secondary with Physics, Chemistry, and Mathematics
timeline.description: Complete Class 12 with the published aggregate and subject-level requirements in Physics, Chemistry, and Mathematics.

streamOptions.notes: This B.Tech route requires the PCM subject combination and the current marks conditions stated by Amrita.

timeline.title: B.Tech CSE with Cyber Security
timeline.description: Complete the four-year specialised degree covering computing foundations, cyber security, practical work, and related professional preparation.
qualificationExamples: B.Tech in Computer Science and Engineering Cyber Security

timeline.title: Optional postgraduate specialisation
timeline.description: Postgraduate cyber security study is an optional continuation for deeper research or specialist work, not a general entry requirement for analyst roles.
qualificationExamples: PhD in a cyber security field

skills.name: Analytical thinking
skills.howUsed: Break down alerts, system behaviour, and evidence to distinguish likely threats from routine activity.

skills.name: Systems and network security
skills.howUsed: Understand how digital systems communicate and where security controls can prevent, detect, or contain misuse.

skills.name: Incident investigation
skills.howUsed: Examine logs and other technical evidence, document findings, and support a coordinated response.

skills.name: Risk communication
skills.howUsed: Explain technical risks and recommended controls clearly to colleagues with different levels of technical knowledge.

skills.name: Continuous learning
skills.howUsed: Keep knowledge current as tools, system architectures, vulnerabilities, and defensive practices change.

careerTimeline.summary: This is an illustrative progression, not a guaranteed ladder. People may remain technical specialists, move into consulting or research, or take a management route depending on their work and organisation.

stages.responsibilities: Monitor alerts, follow established response procedures, document findings, and build reliable knowledge of systems and security controls.
progressionSignals: Investigations are accurate and well documented
Routine incidents are handled with decreasing supervision

stages.responsibilities: Lead more complex investigations, improve detection and protection controls, assess vulnerabilities, and coordinate technical remediation with other teams.
progressionSignals: Owns complex incidents or assessments end to end
Improves controls and team procedures using evidence

stages.responsibilities: Design or review security approaches across systems, guide difficult technical decisions, and help teams balance protection, usability, and operational needs.
progressionSignals: Mentors analysts and engineers through difficult cases

stages.responsibilities: Coordinate people, priorities, risk decisions, and communication while ensuring technical findings lead to accountable organisational action.
progressionSignals: Builds effective security programmes across teams
Communicates risk and trade-offs to senior decision-makers

educationCosts.programName: BS in Data Science and Applications

admissionRoute.description: Qualifier or JEE-based status affects entry. The published programme fee is course-based; documented support depends on category and family income, not the qualifier score.

includes: Published total fees through the BS degree level
excludes: Repeated courses or additional exam charges

educationCosts.programName: B.Tech in Computer Science and Engineering Cyber Security

admissionRoute.description: Amrita states that entrance rank, branch, seat availability, and applicant numbers determine the scholarship slab; it does not publish one guaranteed rank cutoff.

includes: Published annual tuition in scholarship fee slabs

educationCosts.programName: B.Tech in Computer Science and Engineering Cyber Security

admissionRoute.description: AEEE rank or JEE Main percentile is used in seat allotment and can determine scholarship eligibility; learners without a scholarship pay the published regular or non-scholarship slab.

includes: Published annual regular or non-scholarship tuition

assumptions: Divides the published total programme-fee range by the reported annual gross salary
Does not predict employment, salary growth, taxes, loan interest, or personal living costs

outlook.summary: O*NET labels Information Security Analysts a Bright Outlook occupation and reports growth much faster than average. This is U.S. evidence and should not be presented as an India forecast.

regulation.notes: The seven-source pilot does not include an Indian regulator source establishing a universal occupational licence, so regulation status remains unverified.

specializations.title: Incident response
specializations.description: Investigate security events, contain harm, recover operations, and convert lessons into stronger controls and procedures.

specializations.title: Security architecture
specializations.description: Design and review how systems, networks, identity controls, and defensive technologies work together.

tradeoffs.description: Tools, architectures, and threats keep changing, so learning continues well beyond the first qualification.
Published costs differ sharply between the IIT Madras route and private-university fee slabs, and living or equipment costs may be additional.
Some roles include urgent investigations or response work, while other security roles follow more predictable project schedules.

notablePeople.name: Manindra Agrawal
notablePeople.knownFor: IIT Kanpur lists his work across computational complexity, security, theoretical computer science, and algorithms.
notablePeople.whyRelevant: His profile shows how deep foundations in algorithms and theory can connect to security research and long-term technical leadership.

notablePeople.name: Angshuman Karmakar
notablePeople.knownFor: IIT Kanpur lists his research in post-quantum cryptography, side-channel attacks, encrypted computation, and cryptology.
notablePeople.whyRelevant: His work is a concrete Indian example of a specialist path connecting mathematics, computing, hardware behaviour, and future security systems.

notablePeople.name: Urbi Chatterjee
notablePeople.knownFor: IIT Kanpur lists her research in hardware security, physically unclonable functions, hardware reliability, and machine-learning security.
notablePeople.whyRelevant: Her profile demonstrates that cyber security includes hardware and machine-learning systems, not only software monitoring or network defence.

tryThis.title: Threat-model a fictional school club
tryThis.purpose: Practise identifying digital risks and proposing proportionate safeguards without touching any real account or system.
steps: List the fictional club's important information, accounts, and devices
Write down three realistic ways information could be lost, exposed, or misused
Choose one preventive, one detective, and one recovery safeguard for each risk
Explain the plan in plain language to a classmate or family member
reflectionQuestions: Which safeguard reduced the most serious risk without making the club difficult to run?
What evidence would help you decide whether your safeguards were working?
safetyNotes: Do not scan, test, or attempt to access another person's device, account, or network
